project_info.theme: Gloss and blush product display for YSL
project_info.color_palette: Lilac pink, chrome silver, translucent blush pink, pearly peach

main_subject.detail: Three silver-capped YSL beauty products are arranged diagonally across stepped pastel-lilac display blocks framed by chrome cart rails: a glittery peach gloss, a pale pink glossy product, and a milky white blush-like stick.
main_subject.style: Luxury cosmetic still life, polished retail-display packshot, glossy pastel product styling

items: Top Left: Chrome rail structure forming a shopping-cart-like frame
Top Right: Soft lavender studio background with gentle reflections
Bottom Left: Glittery peach product lying diagonally on the lower step
Bottom Right: Frosted pale pink product and milky white stick overlapping on upper steps with shiny chrome caps
Center/Background: Layered pastel-lilac blocks creating a geometric retail display platform

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Bright chrome reflections, soft pastel shadows, translucent bottle glow, crisp luxury cosmetic finish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury product still life for YSL. Centerpiece is three silver-capped YSL beauty products arranged diagonally on stepped pastel-lilac display blocks inside a chrome rail frame: one glittery peach gloss, one soft pink glossy product, and one milky white stick-like product. Background is a clean lavender studio set with geometric platforms. Technical style: photoreal luxury product still-life photography, clean studio product lighting, bright chrome reflections and translucent bottle glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Three YSL silver-capped beauty products
assets.usage: Preserve the packaging proportions, silver cap reflections, and liquid colors

assets.name: Pastel stepped display blocks
assets.usage: Match the stepped lilac platforms and the overall diagonal arrangement

assets.name: Chrome cart rail frame
assets.usage: Keep the metallic rail grid framing the top and sides of the composition

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Maintain the clean still-life geometry and high-spec chrome reflections. The frame rails and stepped platforms are part of the product identity here and should not be removed.
